messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['The most recent ALERTS for your account are now available to download online.', 'This is the last observation to indicate you as of 08 Oct 2016 that you have not yet updated your iTunes ID information.', 'YOUR ACCOUNT HAS BEEN FLAGGED AS ONE OF THE NUMEROUS ACCOUNTS THAT NEEDS TO BE REVIEWED.', 'We regret to inform you that we had to lock your Lloyds TSB account access because we have reasons to believe that it may have been compromised by outside parties.', 'We are unable to process this payment to your account as your details has not been updated', "In accordance with Egg's User Agreement, your account access will remain limited until the issue has been resolved.", 'This e-mail has been sent to you by BT Internet to inform you that we were unable to process your most recent payment of bill.', 'we have noticed invalid login attempts into your account, due to this we are temporarily limiting and restricting your account access until we confirm your identity.', 'In connection with this, we have set suspension for 3 days for the activation request of the purchasing.', 'We recently reviewed your account, and suspect that your HSBC account may have been accessed by an unauthorized third party.', 'NatWest Bank: Online Form Released (Wed, 11 Jun 2008 22:30:12 -0500)', 'Your Internet Banking Password was entered incorrectly 3 times.', 'You may be getting this message because you have logged in from a different location or device.', 'Unfortunately, your recent transactions was declined because your Co-operative Bank online account is currently restricted.', "Methought you'd like to know that Amazon shipped your item, and that this completes your order.", 'During a recent screening, we noticed an issue regarding your account.', 'OUR SECURITY DEPARTMENT DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
